verdict.rationale: Vonage documents a Media Router media mode that relays multiparty media and reduces bandwidth. With single peer connection, a client's subscriber streams from different publishers are delivered through one connection to the Media Router, which implies per-subscriber forwarding. missing for 10: explicit statement that only subscribed tracks are forwarded (SFU semantics), detailed architecture docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to

citations.quote: With single peer connection enabled, all subscriber streams for a client are delivered with a single connection to the Media Router (even if they are published by different clients).
The Media Router can decrease bandwidth usage in multiparty sessions.
The switch between peer-to-peer relaying and Media Router relaying is handled transparently by the client SDKs.
